newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June consumer confidence highest since Aug 1969.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June consumer confidence highest since Aug 1969.

text.p: Americans' confidence in the economy in June was at the highest level since August of 1969, the Conference Board said on Tuesday.
The private business research group said its index of U.S. consumer confidence rose to 129.6 for the month, the highest since August 1969's reading of 131.7.
The Board said the expectations component of the index, which has proven to be a key measure of future business activity, fell slightly to 110.7 in June from a revised 111.4 in May.

"Despite a slight change in consumers' short-term expectations, consumers continue to be bullish about the economy," said Lynn Franco, associate director of The Conference Board's Consumer Research Centre.
The May consumer confidence index reading was revised slightly upward to 127.9 from 127.1.
The present situation component rose to 157.8 in June from a revised reading of 152.6 in May, the Board added.
